verdict.rationale: Netlify's official CLI deploys a project straight from the working directory with a single `netlify deploy --allow-anonymous` command, with no login required, so the deploy half of the story is documented. Nothing shows a CLI command that scaffolds a new project, and the starter templates in the integrations directory are not tied to a CLI scaffold step. Missing for 10: a CLI scaffold/init command for new projects, evidence that scaffold and deploy happen in one command, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can scaffold and deploy a new project with a single CLI command

citations.quote: Deploy directly from your working directory. No login required to start.
Deploy sites, run local dev servers, and manage your Netlify projects right from the terminal with this powerful command-line tool.
